title: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale

title_lang.en: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale
title_lang.zh_hk: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale

synopsis:
From the Philippines to the world, SB19's historic Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale comes to cinemas worldwide.
Captured before a record breaking crowd of nearly 100,000 fans, the film showcases the group's biggest hits, spectacular production, and world class performances that have made SB19 one of Asia's most influential acts.
Presented in SCREENX and 4DX, audiences can experience the scale, sound, and energy of the concert like never before.
Experience the power of GENTO, What?, and DAM as the Philippines' biggest pop phenomenon takes over the big screen in an unforgettable celebration of music, fandom, and legacy.
More than a concert film, it is the story of a movement—one built by five artists, millions of fans, and a dream that helped redefine Filipino music for a new generation.
